feed.title: The fourth fire shift — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Does the town fund a fourth fire shift, and out of the override or the regular budget?

entry.title: Now following: The fourth fire shift
entry.summary: Does the town fund a fourth fire shift, and out of the override or the regular budget?

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Town Meeting, 2026-05-02
entry.summary: Public safety category total (police, fire, dispatch, animal control). Town manager attributed most of the balance-budget increase to adding a fourth fire shift, offset by cuts elsewhere in the department.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Select Board, 2026-04-14
entry.summary: Fire department fourth shift cost. A resident cites this as the cost of adding a fourth fire department shift within the balanced budget.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Select Board, 2026-04-07
entry.summary: Article L: FY27 balanced/omnibus budget, including extended debate over the assistant town manager, fourth fire shift, and free cash

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Finance Committee, 2026-04-06
entry.summary: Fire department fourth shift and added staffing. A member said the fire chief's budget added a person to every shift beyond the fourth-shift addition itself, and that this was hard to get a straight answer on in the chief's presentation.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: School Committee, 2026-03-18
entry.summary: Chair's report: fourth fire shift moved from override to regular town budget, concerns about override odds and ambulance staffing

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Select Board, 2026-03-16
entry.summary: Fire Department: fourth shift retained, per diem coverage cuts, chief transition salary reserve, impact statement read

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: School Committee, 2026-03-10
entry.summary: Urged one unified override covering fire fourth shift and specific school positions rather than splitting it into pieces by department.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Select Board, 2026-03-03
entry.summary: Fire department fourth shift proposal. The fire chief presented a fourth-shift staffing proposal at a prior meeting; a board member noted it and the school budget together are expected to drive the need for an override, though no cost figure was given in these captions.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Finance Committee, 2026-02-19
entry.summary: Fire department will use Noba mitigation one-time funds for added predium (call staff) staffing in FY26 and set aside funds for paramedic training in FY27, rather than offsetting the fourth shift's ongoing cost.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Select Board, 2026-02-17
entry.summary: Announcements. Citizens Party Caucus March 9; Fire Department fourth shift proposal presentation February 24 announced

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Select Board, 2026-01-27
entry.summary: Fourth shift fire department. Cost for adding fourth shift to Fire Department

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: School Committee, 2026-01-27
entry.summary: Public comment: firefighters' union president calls for an override to fund a fourth fire shift

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Finance Committee, 2026-01-27
entry.summary: Fourth shift fire department. Fourth shift fire department costs identified as major budget driver.

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Finance Committee, 2026-01-12
entry.summary: Fire Department fourth shift request. Fire Department requested fourth shift estimated at approximately $500,000

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: Finance Committee, 2026-01-08
entry.summary: FY27 Proposition 2½ Override. Potential Prop 2½ override by schools discussed; Committee seeking alternative solutions rather than override

entry.title: The fourth fire shift: School Committee, 2025-09-30
entry.summary: Fire Dept. FY27 salary increase for 4th shift. The fire chief said the salary increase reflects three step-two firefighter paramedics and one promotion to lieutenant, based on the current collective bargaining agreement.
